text.p: Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd (PBL) said on Tuesday it had appointed Peter O'Connell director of PBL Enterprises and that O'Connell would be in charge of PBL's investments in the telecommunications and gaming areas.
PBL owns half of the Sky Channel racing broadcast network along with News Corp Ltd.

PBL also owns 60 percent of paging group Matrix Telecommunications Ltd and recently announced a deal whereby it would acquire a 10 percent stake in Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd as well as management control of the casino from American group Showboat Inc.

O'Connell was managing director of corporate advisor Hargrave Consultants Pty Ltd and was actively involved in the establishment of Australia's second telecommunications carrier, Optus Communications and was on the board of that company in 1993 representing U.S. shareholder, BellSouth Corp.
